items.title: What is a Market?
items.explanation: A market is a place where people buy and sell goods. It can be a physical location like a bazaar or haat, or an online platform. Goods become available to individuals, households, and businesses through markets. Markets connect people, traditions, and ideas.

items.title: Types of Economic Activities
items.explanation: Goods in markets result from various types of economic activities: primary (e.g., farming for vegetables), secondary (e.g., processing fruits into juices), and tertiary (e.g., selling mobile phones or clothes). These activities transform raw materials into goods that reach consumers.
